newsitem.title: NORWAY: Phillips hopes to restart Ekofisk on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Phillips hopes to restart Ekofisk on Saturday.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum said on Friday it hoped to restart oil production at the North Sea Ekofisk field on Saturday.
The 350,000 barrel per day Ekofisk development was shut in early on Tuesday after a gas leak was detected in a 30 inch oil pipeline.
Output from third party fields -- British Petroleum's Gyda and Ula and Amoco's Valhall and Hod -- and the Statpipe gas line was uninterrupted by the shutdown.
Phillips spokesman Sander Bull-Gjertsen said work to replace a section of the pipeline was ongoing.
"We hope we will restart production tomorrow," Bull-Gjertsen said.
On Wednesday traders said Phillips had declared force majeure on Ekofisk cargoes loading at Britain's Seal Sands terminal, to which the crude is piped.
